title: Reusable batch config
description: A reusable batch config describing a remediation or QA batch as generic factory input. Arabic governs; Chinese is internal reference only unless officially authorized. Not legal advice.

source_basis.description: Source basis under the repository review model, e.g. official_source_based.

repository_legal_review.description: Repository-owner legal review (legal background / bachelor_of_law; repository_owner_review_active).

external_legal_review.description: External legal review status (optional for enterprise/official adoption; not required for repository use).

official_status.description: Official-status boundaries (no official government publication/translation/adoption; not legal advice).

human_legal_review_required.description: Deprecated: superseded by repository_legal_review + external_legal_review. Optional for backward compatibility only; not the central review model.
